message.content: During the conversation, MalfurionStormrage expresses enthusiasm about the idea of setting up a little gathering once the flowers are settled. He suggests that this gathering could be a "nice way to enjoy the garden together" and even proposes the idea of setting up a little area for children with crafts or simple games to keep everyone entertained. This gathering would serve as a community event to celebrate the completion of the garden and allow the community to enjoy the newly blooming flowers together.
